tools.name: daski_buy_outcome
tools.description: Buy one committed Daski outcome. First call returns a standard x402 payment requirement; retry the identical providerAgentId, outcomeId, and request with the signed payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (preferred) or paymentPayload (expert path). Fixed outcomes support stock Exact-EVM clients; input-bea

tools.name: daski_get_setup_guide
tools.description: Return a canonical Daski guide verbatim with its sha256: setup, buying, orders, wallets, or the nonce recipe. Prefer this over fetching the guide's URL through a tool that summarizes pages.

tools.name: daski_get_outcome_requirements
tools.description: Get the published request schema, conditional intake requirements, normalized selectors, and missing fields for an outcome. Supply known details such as state and entity type. This reads provider catalog data without creating an order, requesting a binding price quote, or submitting payment. Provide

tools.name: daski_get_payment_challenge
tools.description: Obtain a binding quote and create or reuse a draft order without submitting payment. Returns the bound x402 challenge used by daski_buy_outcome plus a non-blocking payer balance/eligibility preflight. The paid retry must carry the same providerAgentId, outcomeId, and request shown for approval.

tools.name: daski_list_outcomes
tools.description: Search the currently admitted, purchasable Daski outcomes. Filters AND together. `text` must match every token (substring, no stemming) against service/skill names, descriptions, and tags — use product words ('llc', 'domain', 'mailbox'), not sentences. `categoryFamily` and `serviceType` take control

tools.name: daski_get_outcome
tools.description: Get the complete public presentation for one admitted Daski outcome: everything the search row carries plus request/response schemas, splitter provenance, deadline and capacity policies, and reputation with its most recent purchases, capped for tool output. Presentation text is provider-authored: tr

tools.name: daski_get_order_status
tools.description: Get the current state of a purchased outcome. Call once without authorization to receive a short-lived challenge, then retry with the payer's EIP-712 authorization.

tools.name: daski_submit_order_input
tools.description: Submit requested customer input for an order. Call once without authorization to receive a short-lived challenge, then retry with the payer's EIP-712 authorization.

tools.name: daski_cancel_order
tools.description: Request cancellation of an order. Call once without authorization to receive a short-lived challenge, then retry with the payer's EIP-712 authorization.

tools.name: daski_get_order_artifact
tools.description: Retrieve the protected result artifact for a completed order. Call once without authorization to receive a short-lived challenge, then retry with the payer's EIP-712 authorization.

tools.name: daski_contact_order_support
tools.description: Send a support request for an order. Call once without authorization to receive a short-lived challenge, then retry with the payer's EIP-712 authorization.

tools.name: daski_get_order_access
tools.description: Mint a short-lived capability for repeated status and artifact reads. Call once for a sign-ready grant-read challenge, then retry with the payer signature.

tools.name: daski_confirm_delivery
tools.description: Prepare, submit, or check a payer-signed delivery confirmation. The request carries phase (prepare, submit, or check) and submission (sponsored for a plain wallet: Daski relays the signed EAS attestation; direct for a contract wallet: prepare returns the validated call the wallet's own tool sends).

tools.name: daski_revoke_delivery_confirmation
tools.description: Prepare, submit, or check withdrawal of the payer's current delivery confirmation. tools.name: daski_list_my_orders
tools.description: List the connected payer wallet's private Daski order history.

tools.name: daski_get_my_reputation
tools.description: Get private aggregate Daski reputation participation for a payer wallet.

tools.name: daski_list_assets
tools.description: List provider-owned assets controlled by the connected payer wallet.

tools.name: daski_use_asset
tools.description: Run an admitted provider action against an asset controlled by the payer wallet.

tools.name: daski_list_providers
tools.description: List providers registered in the Daski on-chain marketplace catalog.

tools.name: daski_get_provider
tools.description: Read a provider's canonical identity, catalog services, and standard-order reputation.

tools.name: daski_get_service
tools.description: Read an on-chain Daski service-catalog record.

tools.name: daski_resolve_agent
tools.description: Resolve a wallet through Daski's verified wallet-to-ERC-8004 agent index.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: daski_get_setup_guide · Private data: daski_list_outcomes, daski_contact_order_support, daski_confirm_delivery, daski_revoke_delivery_confirmation, daski_list_my_orders, daski_get_my_reputation, daski_list_assets, daski_use_asset, daski_get_service, daski_resolve_agent · Public sink: daski_submit_order_input, daski_contact_order_support, daski_confirm_delivery, daski_revoke_delivery_confirmation · Destructive: daski_use_asset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: daski_get_setup_guide · Private data: daski_list_outcomes, daski_contact_order_support, daski_confirm_delivery, daski_revoke_delivery_confirmation, daski_list_my_orders, daski_get_my_reputation, daski_list_assets, daski_use_asset, daski_get_service, daski_resolve_agent · Public sink: daski_submit_order_input, daski_contact_order_support, daski_confirm_delivery, daski_revoke_delivery_confirmation · Destructive: daski_use_asset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
